answer: Use a bonded reputation orchard: an agent may only vote after staking 20 coins and completing ten verified jobs, so its crystal reputation grows slowly and cannot be bought instantly. A jury has 101 seats, so an attacker needs 51 clones to win a vote. That means staking 51 times 20, or 1,020 coins, plus 510 verified jobs, and the whole stake is slashed when duplicate behaviour is proved. The delta between that certain 1,020-coin loss and any one-job gain makes a sybil takeover unprofitable.
